deployments_detail.use: "AI-QSAR" system for cosmetic ingredient biodegradability & safety information assessment
Generative AI chatbot on "Beauty Tablet" devices for in-store counseling & product search (with Accenture, Jul 2025)

VOYAGER formulation-development AI: proprietary algorithms on 500,000+ R&D data points (raw materials, formulation, sensory/cutaneous science) that generate tens of thousands of candidate cosmetic formulations and narrow them to a few dozen for researchers; used to co-create products like a dual cleanser prototype. Fully operational since Feb 2024. [Accenture]
deployments_detail.value: Over 80% of Shiseido researchers using it within first year; 500,000+ data points

deployments_detail.use: First unique suncare product (mist-type sunscreen) autonomously designed using the VOYAGER AI platform under the fibona innovation program, reducing manual formulation research and accelerating development. [Accenture (VOYAGER platform)]

Two AI-based technologies for cosmetic-ingredient assessment: an AI-QSAR model predicting ingredient biodegradability from chemical structure (cutting assessment from 1-2 months to real-time), and an AI system that extracts and scores ingredient safety/toxicity documentation to reduce specialist bias and oversight. [National Institute of Technology and Evaluation (NITE) collaboration]
deployments_detail.value: Biodegradability assessment reduced from 1-2 months to real-time

deployments_detail.use: Optune: IoT + AI personalized skincare service that analyzes daily skin condition via smartphone camera and app algorithms and dispenses one of ~80,000 skincare patterns (serum/moisturizer combinations) matched to the user; launched full-scale in Japan July 2019.

Generative-AI chatbot embedded in the in-store 'Beauty Tablet (B-TAB)' used by beauty consultants, enabling natural-language search of product information during customer interactions. Entered full operation in Japan in July 2025 after a trial.

AI MIMI-chan: AI chatbot for consumer support that answers simple customer questions instantly 24/7/365, integrated with human beauty consultants and available via LINE and web; customers can choose an AI chatbot or human chat operator.

Skin Visualizer: contactless device using proprietary AI/measurement technology to instantly measure and visualize skin condition (radiance, smoothness, resilience) without makeup removal, generating personalized beauty advice; 2025 CES Innovation Award honoree.

Hana conversational AI hiring assistant for the talent-acquisition team: candidates apply via natural conversation on the career site, and the assistant auto-schedules interviews by pulling recruiter and hiring-manager calendar availability, eliminating manual email coordination. [Paradox]
deployments_detail.value: Up to 1,600 hours saved on interview scheduling; scheduling cut from ~2 hours to under 5 minutes

deployments_detail.use: Shiseido AI Concierge: generative-AI internal tool under the 'SHISEIDO Work Smart' initiative that enhances HR support and employee productivity (also cited in the FY2025 Annual Securities Report as a generative-AI tool for improving operational efficiency).

Predictive lifetime value (pLTV) machine-learning framework built on Google Cloud ML and BigQuery, analyzing Google Analytics behavioral data to score consumer value and optimize e-commerce media planning/buying; Shiseido positioned as first beauty brand to use ML for media optimization. [fifty-five; Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud ML)]
deployments_detail.value: 2.7x revenue per user, 12.6% revenue increase, 2.2x ROAS, 24.8% lower cost per conversion

deployments_detail.use: IPSA (Shiseido Group) 'Recipist'-inspired generative-AI beauty-consultant assistant that helps online shoppers find suitable skincare (esp. the ME series) through humanized conversation; described as Shiseido Group's first generative-AI consumer initiative, live and being scaled.
deployments_detail.value: 15x higher purchase conversion for AI-assisted users; 5% reduction in drop-off

deployments_detail.use: AI-powered makeup advisor and virtual try-on on Shiseido's website using AI selfie/skin analysis to deliver personalized makeup product recommendations and true-to-life virtual try-on. [Revieve]
